name: REEVES
description: REEVES: an 8- or 16-voice bi-timbral poly in the style of the Prophet Rev2. Two oscillators with shape mod, sub, noise and sync, a Curtis-style 4-pole or 2-pole low-pass, three envelopes, four LFOs, eight mod slots, an effect, arp, poly and gated sequencer per layer, stack and split. The same engine as the REEVES VST3.
author: swtdr34mz
